live_v81.root_cause_scope: Observed list selectors are distinct and correct in tool output. The model concatenates parent and child into a source block and cannot recover from the generic exact-item refusal. This is one fixed seed on two public tasks, not a general causal diagnosis. The assertion policy is bundled with compact metadata and no mismatch guard is exercised; its independent efficacy is unmeasured.

limitations: Two tasks at one seed, four fresh sessions; not an overall benchmark accuracy estimate.
Candidate bundles primary assertions and compact metadata; no assertion-mismatch guard was exercised.
